You can copy the address and use it on another device:

1. Tap Select photos and videos and pick up to 10 items (20 in the full version).
2. DiveLens corrects each one automatically. The grid shows the corrected result.
3. Tap an item to check it full screen, and adjust the strength if you like.
4. Tap Export to save corrected copies to the DiveLens album in your gallery. Your originals stay as they are.

Hold on a photo or video to see the original. Let go to see the correction again.
Double-tap or pinch to zoom a photo, up to its real pixels.
Swipe left or right to go to the next or previous item.
On videos, tap play or pause, and drag the time bar to move through the clip.

The slider under each item sets how strong the correction is, from 0% (the original) to 100%. Auto marks the default. Reset goes back to it, and Apply to all uses the current strength for every item in the set.

Videos play corrected in the viewer, and the correction follows the colour as it changes with depth. DiveLens reads MP4 and MOV videos in H.264 or HEVC. HDR videos are exported in standard range.\nAn export keeps the sound and the date taken. It runs in the background with a notification, where you can also cancel it.

Photos and videos never leave your device. DiveLens corrects them on your phone and has no accounts. Only purchases go through Google Play. Exported copies keep the date and orientation, but not the location.
